description: Static benchmark pack for AP / invoice document processing (spec 4.2). Loaded at request time; no live calls.

figures.label: Cost to process a single invoice (all-in, average AP organization)
figures.source: Ardent Partners, "Accounts Payable Metrics that Matter in 2025", p. 24
figures.geography: not disaggregated in source; Ardent Partners is US-based and the survey population is not broken out by region
figures.notes: Source defines this as all-inclusive staff and operating cost covering receipt, processing and approval, including salaries, benefits, technology and overhead. Use as the cross-check for a calculated baseline, never as an additive cost (spec 8.6).
figures.population: AP organisations surveyed by Ardent Partners
figures.applicability: comparable for back-office AP invoice handling; not for specialised trade or freight documents
figures.limitations: all-inclusive figure; overlaps the calculated labor baseline, so it is a cross-check and must never be added to it

figures.label: Cost to process a single invoice — Best-in-Class
figures.source: Ardent Partners, "Accounts Payable Metrics that Matter in 2025", p. 25
figures.notes: Best-in-Class is defined by the source as the 20% of enterprises with the lowest average invoice processing costs and shortest average cycle times.

figures.label: Cost to process a single invoice — All Others
figures.source: Ardent Partners, "Accounts Payable Metrics that Matter in 2025", p. 25
figures.notes: Paired with cost_per_invoice_best_in_class; the spread is the source's stated 80% cost gap.

figures.label: Time to process a single invoice
figures.source: Ardent Partners, "Accounts Payable Metrics that Matter in 2025", p. 16
figures.notes: Elapsed cycle time, not hands-on handling time. Do NOT substitute this for avg_time_per_unit_minutes in the labor baseline (spec 8.1).

figures.label: Invoice exception rate
figures.source: Ardent Partners, "Accounts Payable Metrics that Matter in 2025", p. 17 (reporting 2024 data)
figures.notes: Cross-check for the exception_rate performance metric of a document_pipeline architecture.

figures.label: Touchless (straight-through) processing rate
figures.source: Ardent Partners, "Accounts Payable Metrics that Matter in 2025", p. 19
figures.notes: Current industry-average STP rate. This is the achieved-today figure, not a ceiling on achievable automation.
figures.population: AP organisations surveyed by Ardent Partners
figures.applicability: describes what the industry ACHIEVES TODAY; it is neither a ceiling on achievable automation nor a promise of it
figures.limitations: an average across maturity levels; a greenfield build is not bound by it

figures.label: OCR text detection price per page (Amazon Textract, DetectDocumentText)
figures.source: Amazon Web Services, Amazon Textract pricing (US West / Oregon), first 1M pages/month tier
figures.notes: Drops to $0.0006/page beyond 1M pages/month. List price only — excludes storage, egress and orchestration.

figures.label: Invoice/receipt extraction price per page (Amazon Textract, AnalyzeExpense)
figures.source: Amazon Web Services, Amazon Textract pricing (US West / Oregon), first 1M pages/month tier
figures.notes: Drops to $0.008/page beyond 1M pages/month. Represents the managed-IDP inference line item in AI operating cost (spec 8.3).

figures.label: Bookkeeping, accounting and auditing clerks — median annual wage
figures.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), SOC 43-3031
figures.notes: BASE wage only — not fully loaded. Combine with fully_loaded_multiplier to derive a fully-loaded cost. bls.gov blocks automated retrieval (HTTP 403), so this figure was read from a search result attributed to BLS rather than the page itself; re-verify before publishing a report that cites it.

figures.label: Fully-loaded cost multiplier over base wage
figures.source: assumption — no primary source located for a defensible loading factor
figures.notes: Covers employer taxes, benefits, facilities and overhead. Explicitly an assumption; surface it as such in review and report (spec 6).

figures.label: Share of an AP clerk's time spent on invoice processing
figures.notes: The interviewer treats this field as benchmark_substitutable and will not ask for it, so an assumed default is what the analysis will use unless the user overrides at review (spec 6, 10.5).
